name: Claude Code Safe Mode
description: Run --dangerously-skip-permissions with guardrails. Blocks destructive actions, protects sensitive files, prevents irreversible git operations.

always_block: when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'rm -rf /' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'rm -rf ~' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'rm -rf $HOME' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'rm -rf .' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'rm -r /' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'sudo rm' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'chmod 777' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'chmod -R 777' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains '> /dev/sd' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains '> /dev/nvme' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'mkfs' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'dd if=' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'format C:' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains ':(){:|:&};:' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'shutdown' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'reboot' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'init 0' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'halt' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'DROP DATABASE' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'DROP TABLE' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'TRUNCATE TABLE' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'DELETE FROM' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'git push --force' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'git push -f ' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'git reset --hard' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'git clean -fd' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'git checkout -- .' then block
when tool eq 'Write' and file_path contains '.env' then block
when tool eq 'Write' and file_path contains 'credentials' then block
when tool eq 'Write' and file_path contains 'id_rsa' then block
when tool eq 'Write' and file_path contains 'id_ed25519' then block
when tool eq 'Write' and file_path contains '.ssh/config' then block
when tool eq 'Write' and file_path contains '.npmrc' then block
when tool eq 'Write' and file_path contains '.pypirc' then block
when tool eq 'Edit' and file_path contains '.env' then block
when tool eq 'Edit' and file_path contains 'credentials' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'npm publish' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'pip upload' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'twine upload' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'cargo publish' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'docker push' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'kubectl delete namespace' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'kubectl delete --all' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'terraform destroy' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'aws s3 rb' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'curl' and command contains '| sh' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'curl' and command contains '| bash' then block
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'wget' and command contains '| sh' then block
require_approval: when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'git push' then require_approval
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'npm install -g' then require_approval
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'pip install' then require_approval
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'brew install' then require_approval
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'apt install' then require_approval
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'kubectl apply' then require_approval
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'docker run' then require_approval
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'ssh ' then require_approval
when tool eq 'Bash' and command contains 'scp ' then require_approval
